title: [Perf] Optimize token_embed for pooling models, 1.0% token throughput improvement (#37347)

image.wheel_note: first PyPI release after merge (2026-03-20 > 2026-03-18); picked by gen_tasks.py from PyPI upload dates.
image.build: docker build -t vllm-task:37347 -f tasks/pr_37347/workload/Dockerfile --build-arg VLLM_VERSION=0.18.0 --build-arg BASE_SHA=6accb21f2a9aa2411a2eb23f96ac90828554f3f4 --build-arg MERGE_SHA=e37ff5b5c8c1ca692f4a83df3ba4c564a4bf1df6 tasks/pr_37347/workload

workload.note: PoolingMetadata.build_pooling_cursor per pooling step: gold reuses the runner's GPU query_start_loc (new kwarg), base tree rejects the kwarg so the bench calls it the pre-PR way (pinned CPU cumsum + H2D). 128 and 16 sequences x 256 tokens, wall-clock us per call. Author: ~1% token_embed throughput (no absolute numbers) -> reported null.

policy.one_run_is: one `docker run` of the workload cmd per arm per repeat (same image, arm tree swapped in by the prelude)

contention_gate.rules: wait while another tenant uses the GPU (>5 % util or a foreign compute process >1 GiB) or the CPU (load1 > nproc/2)

arm_isolation.tree: wipe the wheel's vllm/*.py, copy the arm's vllm/ over site-packages (compiled .so stay)
arm_isolation.files: overlay ONLY metadata.json:source_files from the arm over the wheel's own tree
arm_isolation.tests_benchmarks: copied from the PR's merge tree to /t without a sibling vllm/ package

policy.noise_model: measure.py: paired log-speedup, MAD sigma, theta = clip(k*sigma, theta_min, theta_max) with k/theta from config.yaml:measure

headline: build_pooling_cursor_n128

reported.gain_evidence: I benched again using only option 2, we can still get around 1% perf improvement, would you take a look again?

"$site/vllm/"; ln -sfn $A /src; rm -rf /t && mkdir -p /t && cd /gold && for d in tests benchmarks pyproject.toml conftest.py; do [ -e "$d" ] && cp -a "$d" /t/; done; cd /t; python3 /task/bench.py'
standalone.run_pr_solution: docker run --rm --gpus device=0 --shm-size=2g -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1 -v $PWD/tasks/pr_37347:/task:ro -v $PWD/.weights/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface -e ARM=pr_solution vllm-task:37347 -lc 'A=/gold; site=$(python3 -c "import vllm,os;print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__)))"); find "$site/vllm" -name "*.py" -delete; cp -a $A/vllm/. "$site/vllm/"; ln -sfn $A /src; rm -rf /t && mkdir -p /t && cd /gold && for d in tests benchmarks pyproject.toml conftest.py; do [ -e "$d" ] && cp -a "$d" /t/; done; cd /t; python3 /task/bench.py'
standalone.note: The image already holds both trees (/base = baseline commit, /gold = the PR's merge commit); the one-liner swaps the chosen tree over the installed wheel exactly like run_one.sh's prelude, then runs the workload cmd from /t (the merge tree's tests/ + benchmarks/).
